blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-reviewed 2026-08-08. The current Plasma implementation's pause is confined to mint and redeem paths, and its restriction-manager role only administers minter/redeemer roles; no current holder-transfer blacklist, freeze, seizure, or arbitrary holder-burn hook was found. Yuzu's Hypernative/Sentinel documentation describes surgical blocking of malicious wallets from protocol interactions, but does not establish that this control can intercept an ordinary yzUSD ERC-20 transfer. Current reserves also contain issuer-freezable USDT0, syrupUSDT, syrupUSDC, syrupUSDG, USTB, mGLOBAL, USDe, sUSDe, and AUSD; those controls can impair backing or exits but cannot directly freeze a yzUSD holder balance. The prior inherited verdict was invalid because yzUSD has no single resolvable parent identity. Possible is retained honestly because the documented operational-blocking boundary and issuer legal terms could not be proven to exclude holder-token reach.

oracleRisk.summary: Yuzu documents yzUSD as a pooled, overcollateralized product minted and redeemed against USDT0, with yzPP as a first-loss tranche; it does not describe borrower-owned collateral positions with oracle-triggered liquidations.

branchApplicability.rationale: Yuzu describes yzUSD as a senior pool tranche minted against pooled backing assets and protected by the separate yzPP first-loss pool. Minting, redemption, and loss absorption are pool-level operations rather than borrower-specific debt positions with collateral-ratio liquidations, so no liquidation-oracle branch applies to yzUSD.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: yzUSD's only material deployment is native issuance on Plasma. DefiLlama still reports ~24 yzUSD on a legacy Monad LayerZero OFT (0x9dcB0D17eDDE04D27F387c89fECb78654C373858), but peers(eid) returns zero for all probed endpoint ids on the Monad OFT (re-verified 2026-07-20 at block 88919965) and Yuzu announced it replaced LayerZero with Chainlink CCIP as its exclusive cross-chain infrastructure. The dormant Monad residue is inventoried as a reviewed subthreshold retired route and excluded from material tiering.
